familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Hey, I know you! You're that archaeologist! What was your name again...?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: You don't remember my name?! You don't remember the world famous Asgarnia Smith, archaeologist extraordinaire?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: No... sorry. It's not a very memorable name.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: All that work we did together, and you don't even remember my name.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: To be fair, we never really did that much work together. You sent me on a treasure hunt, but you never really contributed much yourself.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: And a good job I didn't! I never saw a single ounce of gold from that partnership.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Well if a partnership with me was so disappointing, how come you're here?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Bah, I'm not here for you, kid. I'm here for treasure!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: After our last escapade turned out to be pointless, I set out in search of a new adventure! I started off on Karamja, but that didn't really go anywhere...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: In the end, I came back to the desert and dug up this place! I've spent ages trying to work out how to get in, only for you to walk up and open the door right away!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Yeah... funny that. They opened for me because of some magical abilities I gained on our last treasure hunt. You know, that one you were saying was pointless.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Huh... Well, who'd have thought...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Alright then, kid, I'll tell you what... You didn't find us any proper treasure last time around, so now's your chance to redeem yourself!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: I'm sure this place is the key to finding riches beyond imagination, and I, Asgarnia Smith, am willing to enter into a partnership with you, er...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: You don't remember my name either, do you? It's [player name].

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Yes, as I was saying, I, Asgarnia Smith, am willing to enter into a partnership with you, [player name], to uncover those riches!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Who knows, perhaps you'll even learn a thing or two from a master treasure hun- I mean, a master archaeologist like me.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: And I am willing to offer you an exclusive rate of a forty percent split!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Fifty percent.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Absolutely! A forty-five percent split! So, kid, what do you say?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: How about I look around while I think about it?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Of course!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Well, kid, any thoughts on my offer?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: I'm still looking around. I'll decide once I know a bit more about what this place is.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Of course! Take as much time as you need, as long as you don't take long.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Right...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Well, kid, any thoughts on my offer?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Do you not want to hear about what I've found first?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Oh, yes, go ahead!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: According to that plaque over there, this place is a vault that was built to protect the 'mighty treasures' of the 'Empty Lord' from 'the soulless betrayers'.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Mighty treasures, you say? Fantastic! Any idea how to access them?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: I'm guessing it has something to do with these statues. It looks like each of them is meant to be holding something.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Ah, so we need to find whatever it is they should be holding. Classic treasure vault puzzle! Where do you plan to start?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Well hang on there. I haven't actually agreed to anything yet.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: But surely you can't turn down an opportunity like this! You said it yourself: Mighty treasures!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Mighty treasures that we can't access.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Now look here, kid. You won't get far in life with an attitude like that. Is there really nothing else we have to go on?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: We have four names: Vardorvis, Perseriya, Duke Sucellus and the Whisperer.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: They sound like pretty solid leads to me. If we can find these four individuals, maybe we can also find whatever it is we need to get to the treasure.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: That's a big 'if' right there. This vault is clearly Zarosian, which means whoever these four are, they're from thousands of years ago. They're probably all long- dead now.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Zarosian? I'm sure I've heard that term before...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Ah yes! Those recent discoveries at the Digsite! I bet my good friend Terry Balando can help. Why don't you talk to him?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Again, I've not actually agreed to help.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: No, but you're going to. I can tell. The thrill of the adventure is too much to resist. Not to mention that thirty percent split!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Fifty percent.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: So we're agreed? Excellent! You'll find Terry at the Digsite Exam Centre. Good luck!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: sigh*

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Good to see you, kid. Did you speak to Terry Balando?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: You know I still haven't agreed to help you, right?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: You'll find Terry at the Digsite Exam Centre. You'd best get going. There's treasure to uncover!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: sigh*

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Hello again. How goes the archaeology?

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.player: Pretty good, thanks. In fact, I've come across something I was hoping you could help me with.
I came across something very interesting down in the desert: A Zarosian vault.

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Zarosian? Like that artefact you found for us?

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.player: Exactly! I'm hoping to learn about four names I discovered on statues within the vault.

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Sounds like an exciting discovery, but I'm afraid I can't help. This 'Zaros' is still mostly a mystery to me. In fact, I'd say you probably know more than I do!

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Well you may well be in luck. We had a new arrival at the Digsite recently who claims to be a Zarosian expert!

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Quite impressive for one of those to exist considering the greatest historians and archaeologists in the world has no knowledge on Zaros until very recently...

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.player: Interesting... Where can I find this expert?

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: He's set up a new dig on the eastern edge of the Digsite. You're looking for... Ah, what was his name again...

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Banikan! You'll be wanting to speak to Dr Banikan!

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.player: Great! I'll head over there and see if I can find him.

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.text: Hello again. Did you speak to Dr Banikan?

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.text: He's set up a new dig on the eastern edge of the Digsite. You'll likely find him there.

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.text: Hello again. How goes the archaeology?

familiar-faces-attempting-to-visit-the-n.text: You haven't been given permission to use that.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Oh... Good day, adventurer.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Banikan? Yes... I am Banikan.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Are you sure? You don't seem very sure...

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: My apologies. I was not expecting company down here, so you caught me a bit off guard.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Hmm... We haven't met before, have we? You seem familiar.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: I don't believe so.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: So tell me, adventurer, what brings you down here?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: I've been told you're a Zarosian expert. I was hoping you could help me with some names.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Names? What names?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Vardorvis, Perseriya, Duke Sucellus and the Whisperer. I believe they were all Zarosians.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Where did you hear these names?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: I found a strange vault down in the desert, on the eastern coast. The names were on four statues inside.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: A Zarosian vault? How curious...

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: I think so. I suspect the information you seek can be found in the very place I'm searching for.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: You seem to be fairly knowledgeable when it comes to the Zarosian Empire, which is quite a rarity these days. How much do you know about its fall?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: I know that Zaros was overthrown by one of his most trusted generals, Zamorak, who became a god as a result.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Spot on! You could teach the so-called experts around here a thing or two. The betrayal of Zaros ultimately led to the God Wars, making it quite possibly the most pivotal moment in all of history.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: However, even to those of us who do know our stuff, much of what happened to the empire following Zaros' defeat is still a mystery. That's why I'm here.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Senntisten, the Zarosian settlement once located here, was believed to be the capital of the empire.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: If my research is right, and I have strong reason to believe it is, the remains of a key military installation are located right beneath us.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: I can definitely think of worse places to discover details on the fall of the empire.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: And you think this military installation could have information on the four names I found?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Absolutely! Any respectable military outpost would have been filled to the brim with key strategic intelligence. I'd expect details on notable Zarosians to be included.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Of course, they wouldn't have wanted that information falling into the wrong hands, so recovering it may not be straightforward...

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Well I do love a good challenge.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Glad to hear it. Now, I have made good progress in excavating these ruins so far, but perhaps you can help me with the final step?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Sounds like something I'd be good at! What do you need me to blow up?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Excuse me?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Well, my first major discovery here involved me blowing a big hole in some rocks to access an ancient temple. Shouldn't be too hard to do that again.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: I'm sorry, what?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: You risked the structural integrity of an ancient temple by blowing it open with explosives?!

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Huh... I guess I never thought about it like that before. Yeah... now that you mention it, that was really quite a stupid idea.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: How about we take just a touch more care with this one?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Good idea. What do you need me to do?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Grab yourself a pickaxe and carefully clear away these rocks. There should be a pickaxe in the crate in the corner.

options.text: So how come you know so much about Zaros?

steps.player: So how come you know so much about Zaros?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: Well... in my travels, I ended up spending a great deal of time in one of the few places Zarosian remnants can still be found. My time studying them filled me with fascination, and sadness.

steps.player: Sadness?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: 'I walked across the sands and saw the ruins of time...'

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: It's an old poem about the rise, and inevitable fall, of kingdoms and empires. Once, Zaros' Empire stretched as far as the eye could see. Now, no one even remembers his name.

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: To think that something that was once so absolute may soon be lost forever... It falls to people like me, and perhaps you as well, to ensure that history isn't forgotten.

options.text: What is it you're searching for here?

steps.player: What is it you're searching for here?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: As I said, I hope to find details about the fall of the Zarosian Empire.

steps.player: Anything in particular though?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: I have a few leads. Details on individuals and artefacts that may have played a key role in the final days of the Empire.

steps.player: Do you think my four names could be connected?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: I'd say it's definitely possible. I suppose there's only one way to find out.

options.text: I'd best get to work.

steps.player: I'd best get to work.

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.text: So what was all that noise I heard?

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.player: It was some sort of ancient golem. I'm guessing it was here to guard the place. Don't worry, I dealt with it.

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.speaker: Dr Banikan

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.speaker: Dr Banikan

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Hello! Here to see the Burning Man?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Well you picked a great day for it! The name's Barus by the way. I work as a historian here. Those Arceuus lot may think they know it all, but I reckon I could tell you a thing or two that even they haven't realised!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.player: Well on that note, what can you tell me about the Burning Man?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: The Burning Man is a monument to a great triumph in Lovakengj history. We're talking thousands of years ago, before Kourend was even a kingdom! Sadly, that does mean some details have been lost to time.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: What we do know is that a great evil threatened the earliest dwarven settlers here. Had that evil prevailed, Lovakengj might never have existed!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Thankfully, with guidance from their brave leader, the settlers were able to overcome this evil! The Burning Man is a reminder of that.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.player: So I'm guessing the monument represents this evil?
But what was it, and where did it come from?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Ah, now that bit is less clear. Have you heard of the Stranglewood?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Not too surprising. It's not a place you'd want to visit. Anyway, that's supposedly where this evil emerged from.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.player: I see. What can you tell me about the Stranglewood?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: You'll find it on the border between the Kebos Lowlands and the Kingdom of Varlamore. It's a cursed place. Few have ever entered, and of those that have, none have returned!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: You know, I heard some chap from Hosidius went missing not too long ago. They reckon he went exploring the Stranglewood. Poor guy.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: It all starts with the Old Ones. They lived here long before humans came to these lands, and these ruins here were once their home.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: What you see around you is the result of their failure. It's known as the Strangler.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: It's some sort of parasite. It was presumably meant to play a role in their transference rituals, but instead it destroyed them. It has remained here ever since.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Exactly. Plenty of unwary fools have fallen victim to the Strangler. If you don't take care, you will share their fate.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: So how do we deal with them?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: The trick is to maintain your distance. They're relatively passive unless you get too close, but if you disturb one, the rest will quickly come running.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: If you need to fight one, try to do it away from the rest!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: And stay off of the tendrils! You'll alert the lot of them to your location! It's like a network.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: Keep my distance and stay off the tendrils. I can do that. So what's our next move?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: The fact that you're still alive tells me you broke into my home and stole some of the potion I made.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: 'Broke in' is maybe a bit strong...

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Call it what you want, it's not important now. What is important is that I believe I can make a more powerful potion using ingredients found here.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: If all goes well, this potion will provide increased immunity against the Strangler. If either of us are to find what we want here, it will be essential.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: So what ingredients do we need?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: As you've no doubt seen, the Strangler infects plant life as well. However, I've come across a small number of plants that seem to have developed immunity.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: First, there's a herb growing atop the cliff just north west of the temple. Second, there are some berries in an old camp on the coast to the south west.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I need to gather some additional ingredients from within the temple. I will meet you back here once I'm done.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: Where can I find those ingredients again?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: sigh*

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I found the herb growing atop the cliff just north west of the temple. The berries were in an old camp on the coast to the south west.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: Okay, I'll see if I can find them.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-kaso.player: Hmm... Kasonde must still be at the temple. Guess I should go and see if he needs a hand.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Damn it! Damn it! This can't happen! It can't!
Kasonde shows you his arm. There's a large bite from one of the Strangled.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: It's fine! This doesn't change anything.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: The infection means nothing!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I was a dead man either way...

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Koreps Syndrome. Common among botanists apparently. You'd have thought we'd have put some effort into finding a cure, but I guess no one ever thinks they'll be the unlucky one.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Don't. Whatever you have to say, I don't want to hear it. Do you know how many times I've heard the word 'sorry'? Do you know how many times people have told me they understand?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Well they don't. I spent every day working away, telling myself that one day I'd finally be able to live my life, but it was all a lie. That was my life, and it was all so... meaningless!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I tried everything. I went to every healer, every mage, every priest.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I went to House Arceuus, and they turned me away! What gives them the right?!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: So no, this doesn't change anything. The Old Ones are my last hope. I either find their secrets, or...

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Look, we're wasting time here! There's a ritual site to the west. Presumably it's where the Strangler was unleashed. It's my best hope now, and it may well be where you'll find what you're after as well.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Take this potion and add those ingredients you gathered to it. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: We're running out of time! I'm running out of time! Drink that potion. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: We're running out of time! I'm running out of time! Get to the ritual site, now!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: We're running out of time! I'm running out of time! Take this potion and add those ingredients you gathered to it. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-vanquishing-v.text: The player enters the Ritual Site
A cutscene plays where the camera rotates around Vardorvis standing in the middle of the Ritual Site and "VARDORVIS" is overlaid in white text.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: Did you reach the ritual site? Did you find anything?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: A key? Maybe it opens these doors... Quick, give it to me!
You give the key to Kasonde.
A cutscene plays. Kasonde exits the locked doors and approaches you.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: Right, I think I have something, but we need to go quickly.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: Back to Kourend of course. You didn't think we'd be able to do this here, did you? I don't have any of the right equipment.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: Yes, I'm all too aware! That's why we need to go now!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.player: But what if you end up spreading it to Kourend?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: That's a risk we're going to have to take. We have no other option!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.player: You can't be serious! We're talking about thousands of lives here! How do you even know this will work? When the Old Ones tried, it killed them!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: I haven't come this far to give up now! This is my last hope! If you won't help me, then step aside!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: I don't have time for this! I can already feel it inside me, changing me! Step aside... now!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.player: I'm sorry, Kasonde, but I can't do that.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: Then you leave me no choice...
The cutscene ends, and Kasonde attacks the player.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: No... Not like this... Not when I'm so close...

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Please... do something... Help me!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: I'm sorry. I didn't want it to be this way, but I couldn't let you endanger all those people.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I just needed more time...

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: I wish I could have helped you find it.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: At the ritual site... you didn't find what you we're looking for.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: It wasn't a question. I knew you wouldn't. You didn't find it... because I already had it.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I had a feeling it was important, that it might have been what you were after, but if I'd given it to you, you wouldn't have helped me.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I couldn't take the risk. You were my last hope...

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: The medallion. You'll find it in a chest back at my hideout. I hope... I hope it...
Kasonde dies.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.text: A cutscene plays as you approach the Ancient Vault. A Mysterious Figure approaches you.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.speaker: Mysterious Figure
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.text: [player name]. I have an offer for you.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.speaker: Mysterious Figure
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.text: You have something that my mistress wants. Give it to me and you will be rewarded.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.speaker: Mysterious Figure
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.text: I think you know what happens if you refuse.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.player: How do I know I can trust you?
This doesn't seem like a very good offer.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.speaker: Mysterious Figure
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.text: It's the only offer you have. Now make your choice.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.player: Well... I like a nice reward as much as the next person, but without any reason to trust you, I'm going to have to decline.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.text: Placing it on the wrong statue:

steps.text: That's the wrong medallion for this statue.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-returning-the.text: Placing it on the right statue:

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.text: Good to see you, kid. Have you had any luck with these statues yet?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.player: I have a medallion that I think one of them should be holding.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.text: Well what are you waiting for? Go and give it to the statue! That twenty percent split won't earn itself.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.player: Once again, I never actually agreed to work with you.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.text: Nonsense! Only a fool would say no to such a lucrative partnership, and you're clearly no fool.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.text: Good to see you, kid. Nice work on that first statue. That treasure will be ours in no time.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.player: Once again, I never actually agreed to work with you.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-as.text: Nonsense! Only a fool would say no to such a lucrative partnership, and you're clearly no fool.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: You are [player name]?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: That's right.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: The Great Guardian wants you to know that there has been a development in our fight against the Abyss.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: What development?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: A magical signal has been detected emerging from the rift. It is not of the Abyss.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Then what is it?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Unknown.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Hmm... I was actually hoping to enter the Scar myself. Perhaps I could investigate this signal while I'm in there.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Nothing can survive the Scar. To enter would not be wise.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: But how do you know nothing can survive? Has anyone actually confirmed that?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: There are a few who have entered the Scar in the past. None have returned.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Well then give me a chance to be the first.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: If you wish to enter, it is not our place to stop you. In the likely event of your demise, you will be mourned.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Thanks... I think. Anything I should know before entering?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: The rift is unpredictable. Normally, you would not be able to control its destination. However, the magical signal coming from within could be of benefit. It could act as a guide.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: So you'd be able to send me right to the source?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Approximately.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Well I suppose that's the best I can ask for.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Are you ready to enter the Scar?

options.text: Yes.

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
steps.text: Then may your death come quick, human. Good luck.

options.text: No.

steps.player: No.

steps.speaker: Catalytic Guardian

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Human... you survived the Scar?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I did.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: How unexpected. The Great Guardian will need to be informed.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: In the meantime, do you wish to return to the Scar?

options.text: Yes.

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Catalytic Guardian
steps.text: Very well. Good luck.

options.text: No.

steps.player: No.

steps.speaker: Catalytic Guardian

praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.text: A cutscene plays. As the player boards, Wizard Persten appears.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.text: Well of course I'm alive, silly. I'm Mia Persten! It takes more than the Abyss to kill me.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.text: Speaking of which, it's a good job I found you. If you'd have got on that boat, you'd have become fish food!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.text: Absolutely! Come, I'll explain back at my camp.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Welcome to my little home away from home. It's not much, but you take what you can get in a place like this.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Is it safe here?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Of course! You won't find anywhere safer in all the Abyss.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Well... that's probably not true, but let's pretend otherwise.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Still, the point is, the demons don't come down here thanks to our fishy friend.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I already had so many questions, but you keep giving me more. What's this fish thing you keep talking about?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: One of the many mysteries of this place. It's some sort of sea creature by the looks of it, but it's nothing like anything I've seen before.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: It's very dangerous, and it's rather annoyingly preventing any navigation of that lovely lake of goo. Quite unfortunate as there's something out there that I really need to get to.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Well thankfully you shouldn't need to anymore.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: How so?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I'm guessing you were responsible for that magic signal leaving this place? The Guardians of the Rift were able to use it to stabilise the rift. It's safe for you to leave now.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Leave? But I don't want to leave? I'm a leading expert on teleportation. I'd have had no problem getting out of here if I'd wanted to.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: What? Then why the signal?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Because I need to get past the big fishy, but I can't do it alone. I was hoping someone capable would follow the signal and join me. Looks like it worked perfectly!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: But why do you need to get past this fish... thing?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: There's a big old ship out there that I believe contains something I need.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: An old ship? Hmm...

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: What is it?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Does the name Perseriya mean anything to you?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Yes! It's her ship I'm trying to reach!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Well she's actually why I'm here as well.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: And there I was thinking you'd come here just for me. Consider my feelings hurt. Still, seeing as we both want the same thing, how about we work together?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Alright, how do we reach this ship?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: That fish creature needs dealing with. I've already tried myself, but its scales are stronger than anything I've ever encountered before.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: It must have some sort of weakness.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Indeed it does. There's a spot on its back where there's a gap in the scales.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: So what's the catch?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Catch? Ha! Good one.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: The weak spot isn't easy to reach, especially with how quickly the creature can move around the lake. If we want to get close, we'll need to trap it. There's an island next to Perseriya's ship that should work.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I see. So what's your plan for trapping it?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: I hope you like your fish smoked, because we're going to smoke this one out!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: How?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: It seems Perseriya was in charge of quite the fleet. Her ship isn't the only one in here. There's plenty of others about, still filled to the brim with all sorts of explosive materials.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Ah, I see. You want to set those ships alight. Where can I find them?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: There's three that I know of, which should be enough for what we need. See those tunnels over there? There's one down each of them.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Two are blocked right now, but I'll get that sorted while you work on the first one. Once you set the ship alight, I'll make sure the smoke is directed right towards our fishy friend.

options.text: How did you survive in here?

steps.player: How did you survive in here?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: It wasn't really that hard. Did you not think I would?

steps.player: The Guardians of the Rift didn't think you'd have any chance.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: Guardians of the Rift? You mentioned them earlier. Who are they?

steps.player: A group of ancient golems built to guard the Temple of the Eye. They've been keeping the rift under control since we opened it.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: Ah, I'm guessing I won't be their favourite person then.

steps.player: Well it was sort of your fault.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: It's not like it was intentional. Besides, we should look on the positive side. I've found all sorts of things in here to help with my research.

steps.player: I'm not sure they'd consider that to be worth the cost.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: Well even if we wanted to, we can't turn back time. We may as well just keep looking forward.

options.text: What is it you want with Perseriya's ship?

steps.player: What is it you want with Perseriya's ship?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: I reckon I'll find some information there to help with my research.

steps.player: What information?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: If I knew that, I wouldn't need to go there, would I?

steps.player: But then how do you know there's information on her ship?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: I found a tablet on another shipwreck down here. It suggested she'd been experimenting with teleportation magic. If that's true, her ship seems the best place to look.

options.text: What's with the demons in this place?

steps.player: What's with the demons in this place?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: To be honest, I'm not totally sure. It's clear the Abyss has demonic connections, hence, you know, Abyssal Demons. But Black Demons? Greater Demons?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: It's obvious they don't belong here. The delightful denizens of the Abyss haven't taken kindly to their presence.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: From the rituals they keep performing, my guess is they're looking to harness the magic of the Abyss for themselves.

options.text: I'll get going.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Any luck with those ships yet?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Not yet.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: There should be one down each of those tunnels over there. Two are blocked right now, but I'll get that sorted while you work on the first one.

options.text: How did you survive in here?
What is it you want with Perseriya's ship?
What's with the demons in this place?
I'll get going.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-entering-a-.player: Not sure if this diving equipment is going to help in here. This... brain juice... is quite thick. I'll give it a go though.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.text: If the player has not acquired the old tablet:

steps.player: I should probably look around and see if I can find anything of interest before I go burning everything.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.text: If the player has acquired the old tablet but not read it:
If the player does not have gunpowder:

steps.text: You try to light the ship's wood, but it's too damp. You will need something else to accelerate the burning.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: You're back! I'm guessing from all the smoke that came this way that all went as planned?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: It did.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Great! I've opened up the second tunnel for you. It's ready when you are.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Before I go, I found something I wanted to ask you about.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: What is it?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I found an old tablet near the ship. It mentioned two artefacts. One was referred to as Imperium and the other as Primus.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Really? They must be code names. I wonder what they refer to...

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Apparently, the one known as Primus was being defended by Saradominists. Perseriya and her fleet were trying to claim it, but things clearly didn't go as planned, hence them ending up here.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: I don't follow.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Isn't it obvious? It must be the Eye.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: You're starting to sound a bit accusational.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I think it's fair to say that you're normally a very upbeat person, but whenever the Eye is mentioned, you start to act... different. I think you know more than you're letting on.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Hmm... Alright, you've got me.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Do you remember me telling you that my travels had taken me to other planes? One of them was a total wasteland. Ruins of a great civilisation as far as you could see.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Naturally, me being me, I was curious. I delved deep into the ruins to try and work out what happened.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Turns out, they were in possession of an artefact of immense power. It was capable of limitless creation, but also unimaginable destruction. It delivered them great prosperity, but also led to their ruin.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: This artefact... The Eye?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: I think so. It's been known by many names, and most of them have been long forgotten. The Eye of Saradomin was one. The Fist of Guthix was another. But its true name is...

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: The Stone of Jas.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: That's right... How did you know that?
If the player has completed While Guthix Sleeps:

steps.player: I've seen it myself.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: You've encountered the Stone?

steps.player: Yes, but I knew about it even before I did. Do you remember that vision I had back in the Temple of the Eye? I saw it. I've somehow known its name ever since, but I just didn't realise until now.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: If the player has not completed While Guthix Sleeps:

steps.player: Do you remember that vision I had back in the Temple of the Eye? I saw it. I've somehow known its name ever since, but I just didn't realise until now.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: How fascinating... Makes sense though. After all, powerful magic leaves powerful traces.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: So all that stuff about you searching for a teleportation nexus? That was a lie, wasn't it? You were really searching for information on the Stone.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Yeah... sorry about that. I had a feeling that if I suddenly popped up claiming to have information on a powerful artefact beyond anything ever encountered before, people might not believe me.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I guess that does make sense. So is that what you're hoping to find on Perseriya's ship? Information on the Stone?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Well I definitely wouldn't complain, but it's actually this other artefact I'm more interested in. The one referred to as Imperium.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: I always assumed the Stone to be unique, but what if it's not? Could there be other artefacts of a similar power out there? I have to find out!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: And on that note, we should really get back to it. Those ships won't burn themselves!

options.text: How did you survive in here?
What do you know about Imperium so far?

steps.player: What do you know about Imperium so far?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: Before you came along, I'd already found quite a few mentions of it hidden in various shipwrecks. It seems that Perseriya possessed it for a time, but it was eventually transported somewhere to the east.

steps.player: And you think it's connected to the Stone of Jas?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: I don't have anything solid, but multiple times it was compared to the Stone. Even if not directly connected, it seems the two were of a similar type of power.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: Beyond that, I don't really have much. If we want to learn more, we need to reach Perseriya's ship.

options.text: What's with the demons in this place?
I'll get going.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.text: If the player has not acquired the damp tablet:

steps.player: There's probably more answers lying around here. I'd better check before I burn it all.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-attempting-.text: If the player has acquired the damp tablet but not read it:
If the player does not have gunpowder:

steps.text: You try to light the ship's wood, but it's too damp. You will need something else to accelerate the burning.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Welcome back. How did things go?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Not too bad. You might be interested in another tablet I found. It mentioned Imperium.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: How exciting! Well don't leave me hanging in anticipation. What did you find?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Apparently a soldier interacted with the artefact at one point. It caused another soldier to enter a frenzy and kill multiple people.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Ah, that must have been a bit of a bother for them.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Yeah... both soldiers in question were later executed.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Oh dear... Still, this is highly useful information. We now know the artefact has the ability to control another, which is equal parts exciting and terrifying!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: The question now is, did the artefact do it on its own, or was it enacting the will of the soldier that touched it?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I guess there's only one way to find out.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Indeed! Just one ship to go. I've managed to open up the final tunnel for you.

options.text: How did you survive in here?
How powerful do you think Imperium is?

steps.player: How powerful do you think Imperium is?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: It's a curious one. We now know Imperium has the power to control another, but that doesn't really tell us much about the overall power of the artefact.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: Mind control is a dangerous form of magic. The Order of Wizards forbid it for obvious reasons, but with enough skill, it is possible to learn.

steps.player: But?

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: Mind controlling magic has a large number of drawbacks. All but the most powerful mages can only use it on one person at a time, and the spell is easily broken.

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: But what if Imperium can overcome these limits? What if it can control hundreds, or even thousands, with no way to break that control!

steps.player: That's terrifying!

steps.speaker: Wizard Persten
steps.text: Indeed it is.

options.text: What's with the demons in this place?
I'll get going.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: First the Stone, and now this 'Imperium'. But that begs the question... how many more? So silly of me! I spent so much time focusing on the Stone, I never even considered the possibility...

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Er... hello?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Oh, you're back! Sorry, I was in my own little world there, chittering away. Anyway, looks like our plan worked. I was able to use all that smoke to force our big fish towards that island!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: So now we just need to properly deal with it.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: That's right! Now don't worry, I have a very in-depth plan. Basically, one of us needs to be ready to direct the smoke in case it tries to escape while the other goes and gives it a good old poke!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: I guess I'll be doing the poking?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Do you have the magical abilities to maintain a huge whirlwind of smoke that's strong enough to prevent a large aquatic lifeform from passing through?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: No.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Then yes, you'll be doing the poking!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Then I guess we should get to it.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Absolutely! Oh, don't forget there's a weak spot on its back that you'll want to try and target. I can't see it letting you get too close, so I reckon you'll want to try and stun it first.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: From my experiences in this place, some sort of shadowy spell should do the trick! I'm sure a capable individual like you has access to something suitable.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Hang on... How do you know about...

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Because I'm Mia Persten, silly! You don't get as far as me without knowing a thing or two about forbidden magic. Now, just hop on the boat and row out to the island when you're ready. Oh, and try not to die!

options.text: How did you survive in here?
How powerful do you think Imperium is?
What's with the demons in this place?
I'll get going.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: That big fish won't go sorting itself out. Just hop on the boat and row out to the island when you're ready.

options.text: How did you survive in here?
How powerful do you think Imperium is?
What's with the demons in this place?
I'll get going.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: As you cross the stepping stones, Persten rows out to join you.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: Alright, let's see what we've got...
Persten rummages around in the debris and pulls out a tablet.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: It can't be possible... can it?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: It's written by one of the crew on Perseriya's ship. Apparently they snuck into her private cabin...

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.player: What's not right about that? Makes sense she'd have kept it close.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: This was after Imperium had already been delivered to the east!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.player: So it was never delivered? But that can't be right... We've found multiple tablets saying it was.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: Exactly! That either means she was able to sneak it back onto the ship again, or there was a second artefact!

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: I don't know... I don't think so... But then again, until recently I didn't even know about this artefact at all.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: I'm not too sure. I need to gather all my research and see what I can come up with. I guess that means that I've outlived my little home here.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.player: So you're going back to the Wizards' Tower?

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: Well... maybe not just yet. I'll have to face the music there at some point, but probably best I wait until after I've got my head around all this Imperium business.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: If you don't mind, I'd appreciate it if you'd not mention what we found here to Sedridor and the others until I'm ready.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.player: Fair enough, but you do need to tell them soon.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.speaker: Wizard Persten
praefectus-classis-perseriya-crossing-th.text: Oh don't worry, I will. Now, I'd best be getting off. I'm sure I'll see you again before long. I hope you find what you're looking for here.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Good to see you, kid. Nice work on those two statues. That treasure will be ours in no time.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Once again, I never actually agreed to work with you.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.text: Nonsense! Only a fool would say no to such a lucrative partnership, and you're clearly no fool.

praefectus-classis-perseriya-talking-to-.player: Hmm... If you say so.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Captain Malleta
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: What do you want, adventurer?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: I need to enter the prison.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Captain Malleta
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: No. General Khazard has ordered us to guard this door. I'm not about to just let you walk through it.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: But you're guarding the door because of that assassin, right? Why does that mean I can't go in?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Captain Malleta
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I don't have time to answer your questions. I've told you that you can't go in, so go away.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Are you not bored of being on guard here? It can't be much fun in this dingy cold dungeon. Food must be a bit meh as well.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Captain Malleta
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: What is your point?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: If that assassin were to be dealt with, Khazard might reconsider your posting. Rather than sitting here waiting around, why not let me go in and find him?
Besides, let's be honest, if I die doing so, Khazard would probably be thrilled.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Captain Malleta
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Hmm...

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Captain Malleta
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Fine. If it stops you bothering me, feel free to go and get yourself killed.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Lovely! Thank you for your time.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.player: Who are you? Are you one of Khazard's soldiers?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: That's right! Made the mistake of sticking my nose where I shouldn't have. Now I've got myself a lovely little cell and no way to get out of it.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.player: Yeah... Seems I've got myself into a similar situation.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: Well, I tell you what, now that you're here, maybe we have a chance to escape!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: No idea, but I'm sure we can come up with something. Anything in your cell that you reckon could be of use?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.player: I'm not sure. Let me take a look.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: If the player has not yet found the letter:

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.text: Keep at it. There must be something we can use.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: If the player has found but not read the letter:

steps.player: I found a letter on a skeleton.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.text: Well read it and see what it says!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: If the player has read the letter:

steps.player: I found a letter on a skeleton.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.text: What does it say?

steps.player: Someone was trying to help some prisoners escape. Might be we can use whatever they left behind to our advantage.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.text: Brilliant! Keep looking and see what else you can find.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: If the player has not read the letter:

steps.player: I am not sticking my hand in there without good reason!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: If the player has read the letter:

steps.player: Eugh! I can't believe I'm doing this.

steps.text: You carefully search the bucket and find a knife... among other things.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-inspec.text: If the player tries to search the bucket again:

steps.text: You carefully search the bucket, but apart from horrors to never be spoken of again, you find nothing of interest.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-search.text: You search the bed and find a loose slab of stone underneath it. You try to use the knife to pry it out of the way, but are unable to do so.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Any luck in there?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: I managed to find a knife.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Oh, pass it through! I reckon I can make use of it.
You pass the knife through the hole in the wall.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Right, give me a moment...

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Okay, I have something! See if you can find a use for this.
The mysterious individual passes a chisel through the hole in the wall.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: I lost that chisel you gave me.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: What? How?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Oh wait, it's on the floor here. Silly me.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: You pick up the chisel.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-search.text: You search the bed and find a loose slab of stone underneath it. You use the chisel to pry it out of the way, but the chisel breaks in the process. Beneath the slab, you find a lockpick.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: How's it going in there?
If the player does not have a lockpick:

steps.player: I'm getting close I reckon.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.text: Good stuff!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: If the player has a lockpick:

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: I managed to find a lockpick.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Mysterious Voice
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Oh, I'm pretty good with those! Pass it through and I'll see if I can get my cell unlocked. Once I'm out, I can free you as well!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.player: Give me one good reason why I shouldn't kill you right now!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: I can give you two. First, because you'll fail. You have no weapons or armour, and even if you did, it wouldn't go well. Second, because without me you'd still be in that cell.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.player: Without me you'd be in a cell as well!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: Correct. Now, while I appreciate you came here to kill me, we are both in each other's debt, so let's set aside the threats and start focusing on more important matters.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.player: Well actually I didn't come here for you. I'm looking for Duke Sucellus.
Apparently he used to be in charge of this place. That letter I found mentioned the asylum, which seems a good place to start my search.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: I suspect your search will be quite a short one as things currently stand.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: It seems you are yet to consider an obvious question. Are you not wondering how I ended up in that cell?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: It was that Mahjarrat. Seems he doesn't think much of you either, as he was also responsible for your own imprisonment.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.player: Jhallan? But he was your prisoner!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: He was, but now he's not. There was an unfortunate mishap.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: I don't know, but he'll be nearby, and we are currently poorly equipped to deal with him. I'm missing my sword and you don't have any weapons either.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.player: Did you see where he put my things?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: They're in a chest in the cell opposite this one, but the cell is locked. My sword is in there as well.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.player: Why do I feel like you have a proposal?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: Because I do, and you'd be wise to listen to it. I came here in search of something, and the asylum is one of the last places I need to look.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: With Jhallan around, neither of us stand a good chance of getting what we want. However, if we work together, we can deal with him and get to the asylum.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.player: Look, I have no reason to trust you.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: No, but you don't have any other options. Now, I suggest you focus on finding the key to that cell so we can recover our equipment. While you do that, I'll work out how to reach the asylum.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: Oh, and you should take this. You might need it.
The assassin gives you a lockpick.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-escapi.text: We'll reconvene once you have the cell open.
