duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Do you have the key?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: I do.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Good. Let's get this cell open.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Not yet. First, you have to give me some answers.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Rather than resorting to needless anger, had you considered just asking first?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Oh... well, why are you here?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I told you, I'm looking for something.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: What?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: A magical artefact called the Frostenhorn.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Frostenhorn?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: You've heard of it?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: I've heard the name, but I don't know anything about it. What is it?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I don't know and I don't need to know. I've been paid to recover it from this place and that's all that matters to me.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Paid by who?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: That's confidential.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Did this person also pay you to steal that relic from Entrana?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: They did.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: And what about all that business with the Hazeel Cult and the Carnilleans?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I needed to recover that crest half from the Carnillean Mansion. Framing the Hazeel Cult was the best cover.
If the player opposed the cult during the quest Hazeel Cult:

steps.player: But why have Hazeel resurrected as part of that?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.text: Because it made it believable. Now, are we done?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: If the player helped the cult during the quest Hazeel Cult:

steps.player: But why try to have Hazeel resurrected as part of that?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.text: Because it would have made it believable. Unfortunately, I failed to account for you having already done so. Now, are we done?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Well... I guess so.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: You seem surprised by that.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: I suppose I wasn't expecting you to be so open about it all.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: You weren't going to open the gate until I provided satisfactory answers, so I provided them.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Why not try to kill me instead? It's not like that's ever been a problem for you before.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I kill when it is the best way to further my goal. That would not have been the case here, so I chose the cleaner and more efficient option.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Besides, beyond placating your curiosity, the answers I gave are rather meaningless. They do not jeopardise me or my employer in any way.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Huh... Fair enough.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Now, once again, let's get this cell open.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Time is wasting. You should get this cell open.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Right, you'll be pleased to know that I've obtained a key that can open the way to the asylum. However, Jhallan must be dealt with before we can use it safely.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: How?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I don't know much about the Mahjarrat, but it's clear they're not easy to kill. Jhallan is thankfully fairly weak for their kind, but that still makes him significantly stronger than us.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Our best option will be to trap him. I suggest we do so by repeating what we did before.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: What we did before?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Yes. You distract him and I take him unaware.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Are you talking about what happened back in that cave? There was no 'we' about that.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: You provided an opportunity and I took it. Your awareness of said opportunity was irrelevant.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Right... So how do I distract him?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: The old refugee camp seems like a good place to spring our trap. I left a pack there with some firecrackers in. The noise should quickly attract his attention.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Once he's there, don't try to be a hero. Just keep him busy until I'm ready.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Is that it?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Yes. Now, let's be on our way.
The assassin collects his sword and departs.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-search.text: The assassin has left everything you could ever need to make a significant amount of noise.

options.text: Yes.
No.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Right, that's him dealt with.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Will that ice hold?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: It should, but it would be unwise to wait and find out. I must resume my search for the Frostenhorn and you have your Duke business to deal with.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: To the asylum then?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Yes. You can get there by heading north. I've already unlocked the gate.
The assassin disappears.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: That is becoming quite tiresome.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Curious...

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: What?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I've checked every corner of this prison now. This room was the last place to look. There is only one possibility: The Frostenhorn isn't here.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: But if it's not here, then where is it?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: A good question, but one that is not my concern. My employer believed it to be here, but was clearly mistaken. That's their problem.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: You don't mind that you failed?

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I did all that was required of me. If they are able to discover the true location of the horn, they are welcome to hire me once more. Until then, my work is done.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: What makes you think I'm going to let you go? You have a whole lot of murders you need to answer for.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Assassin
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: I will not be giving you a choice in the matter. Perhaps justice will be served someday, but not today. Goodbye.
The assassin disappears.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: We're getting close now, kid. Just one more statue to go! I can smell that treasure already!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Once again, I never actually agreed to work with you.

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.text: Nonsense! You'd be a fool to turn away now that we're so close! I'm about to make history - and you'll have helped!

duke-sucellus-of-the-sixth-legion-talkin.player: Hmm... If you say so.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
the-whisperer-talking-to-ramarno.text: Ah, [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.

options.text: What can I do here?
Have you seen any archeologists around here?

steps.player: Have you seen any archeologists around here?

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Human archeologists? Yes, some showed up recently. I told them they'd be fine to look around as long as they were careful. They're probably over by the bank chest.

steps.player: Thanks.

options.text: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
Can I use the Forge?
Never mind, I have no questions for now.

the-whisperer-talking-to-helena.text: If the player never spoke to Ramarno after completion of Below Ice Mountain:

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.text: Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.

the-whisperer-talking-to-helena.text: If the player spoke to Ramarno after completion of Below Ice Mountain:

steps.player: Hello there.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.text: Hello. Sorry, I'd love to stop and chat, but I have a new find that I need to work on. If you need anything, I'm sure Prescott can help.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.text: Not a problem.

the-whisperer-talking-to-prescott.text: If the player never spoke to Ramarno after completion of Below Ice Mountain:

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.

the-whisperer-talking-to-prescott.text: If the player spoke to Ramarno after completion of Below Ice Mountain:

steps.player: Hello there.

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: Hello! Look at this place. Isn't it amazing?

steps.player: It sure is! Not every day you find yourself in a lost city.

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: So what can I do for you?

steps.player: Does the name Lassar mean anything to you? It was an old fortress that once existed here, long before Camdozaal. I'm wondering if there might still be some traces left down here.

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: A ruin within a ruin? How exciting! We have found the odd thing that doesn't seem to be dwarven in origin, but it's still early days for us here, so we haven't been able to learn much yet.

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: One that was particularly interesting was this strange icon I found in the mine.
The archaeologist shows you an unusual icon.

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: Could be a lot more to find over there, but I must admit, I haven't been back since... well...

steps.player: Since what?

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: It's probably nothing, but there's this big sinkhole on the other side of the mine. I'm probably just being silly, but I'm sure I heard a voice coming from inside.

steps.player: Interesting... And if I wanted to go down this hole?

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: Go down the hole?! You're far braver than I am! There's plenty of rocks around there. I'm sure you could tie a rope to one of them. You'd need a pretty long rope though. Here, you can use mine.
The archaeologist gives you some rope.

steps.player: Thanks!

the-whisperer-talking-to-prescott-talkin.player: Hello again. Where did you say that hole was?

the-whisperer-talking-to-prescott-talkin.text: If the player lost their very long rope:

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: You'll find it just on the other side of the mine. You'll need a pretty long rope to get down there though. Here, you can use mine.
The archaeologist gives you some rope.

the-whisperer-talking-to-prescott-talkin.text: If the player has their very long rope:

steps.speaker: Prescott
steps.text: You'll find it just on the other side of the mine. Be careful down there.

steps.player: Thanks!

the-whisperer-talking-to-prescott-talkin.speaker: Prescott
the-whisperer-talking-to-prescott-talkin.text: Hello! Glad to see you're okay. I was worried you might have gone and got stuck down that hole.

the-whisperer-talking-to-prescott-talkin.player: No need to worry. I'm mostly quite capable when it comes to these kinds of things!

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.player: Huh? What happened? Where am I? And who are you?

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: I am Ketla. I found you wandering the streets. It nearly had you. You were nearly lost.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.player: It? What are you on about?

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: An unknowable stranger with a thousand faces. An endless ocean where the lost swim. A fissure in fate that exists beyond time.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: It twists its way into your very soul, devouring all that you are, until by the time it's done, only one question remains...

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: Do you think you can save them?

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: Oh... I'm sorry. Sometimes it becomes difficult to resist the call. It gets harder with every day that goes by.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: Yes. It wants my soul, and I fear it will soon have it. My strength is leaving me and I cannot hold it back. This city will be my doom.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.player: But then why not leave? I'm guessing you're an Imcando dwarf, right? A survivor from Camdozaal? Others of your kind still live. You could leave this place and join them.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: Others still live? I feared I was the last...

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: Well then that is all the more reason to stay. For the good of my people, for all people, it has to be stopped.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.player: Maybe I could help? I'm a pretty good fighter. I'm sure I can deal with whatever this thing is.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: Your weapons are worthless. It is not an evil to be slain.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.player: Then how can we stop it?

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: The totem. It links our world to the shadows... to it.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.player: The shadows? As in the Shadow Realm?
More than know. I've been there! I have a ring that lets me do so.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: A ring? I must see it.
If the player did not bring their ring of visibility:

steps.player: Of course. I don't have it with me, but I can go and fetch it.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Yes. Please bring it to me.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-after-com.text: If the player brought their ring of visibility:

steps.player: Of course. I have it right here.

steps.text: You show the ring to Ketla.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: Do you have the ring?
You show the ring to Ketla.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: Where did you get this?

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.player: A wandering merchant gave it to me. I never asked how he got it.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: There is a great power to this ring, but the shadows here reject it. It must know the ring is a threat.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: On its own, yes. The ring can see into the shadows, but it is not of the shadows. However, I have something that is.
Ketla shows you a fragment of strange black stone.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: A shard of the totem. Too dangerous to use on its own, but with the power of this ring, perhaps I can make it safe.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.player: Sounds like it's worth a go.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: Give me a moment...

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: There. The fragment should be safe to use now.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.player: So what can we do with it?

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: You said the ring let you enter the shadows, but that is not the case. It simply allowed you a small glimpse into their darkness.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: But it rules the shadows. To overcome it, you must enter the shadows as well. The fragment will allow you to do so now.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.player: So I can use this fragment to enter the Shadow Realm? But surely there's going to be a lot of danger entering the domain of this... whatever it is.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: Yes. Once you enter the shadows, you will be at its mercy. Unless you long for the eternal sea, you would be wise not to stay for long.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: It is the only way. You must enter the shadows and destroy the totem.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: Its power is strongest in the sunken cathedral. That is likely where the totem will be found.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.player: And I'm guessing I won't just be able to walk on in there?

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: No. It has blocked the way. You will need to clear the path with cleansing flames.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: The fire of our world will do nothing in the shadows, but the old inhabitants of this city, they tried to fight off the inevitable darkness. They created things that could help you.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: If you find their old schematics, bring them to me. I can use them to create new tools for you.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.player: Alright. Anything else I should know?

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: The fragment won't just work anywhere. To enter the shadows, you must use it where they are strongest. Seek out the places where that is the case. You will know them when you see them.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: That is thankfully easier. The fragment will let you leave the shadows whenever you desire. Be sure to use it before darkness claims you.
Ketla gives you the blackstone fragment.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: Good luck.

options.text: How did you end up down here?

steps.player: How did you end up down here?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: You know of Camdozaal. That means you have seen what became of our home.

steps.player: I have.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: When the barbarians came, many tried to fight. I should have fought with them, but I turned away. I had a duty to my people, but I abandoned them.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: The barbarians had blocked all exits, so the only way to flee was down. I hid down here while my people died, but now I pay the price for my choice.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: There are worse things than death, and this city is home to them all.

steps.player: You shouldn't feel guilty for fleeing. Your people had no hope against the barbarians.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: You misunderstand. Fleeing was not the cause of my guilt. My punishment is for what happened next...

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: It is best you do not know. Please, let us speak of something else.

options.text: What do you know about this city?

steps.player: What do you know about this city?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Lassar. That is what they called this place. It was once home to some of the greatest minds in the world.

steps.player: I knew about the fortress of Lassar, but I had no idea a city was here as well.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: It seems they kept it hidden on purpose. This city was a place of discovery, where magic and science were practiced in equal measure. They did not want their secrets falling into the wrong hands.

steps.player: I guess that's how this place is so well preserved. No one even knew it was here.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Yes. They remained hidden down here long after their fortress fell. They were still here even after the construction of Camdozaal.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Their isolation kept them safe for a time, but when darkness fell, there was no one to hear their screams.

options.text: Can you tell me any more about this entity?

steps.player: Can you tell me any more about this entity?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: It is beyond our understanding. It exists in the shadows, and there it should remain, but the blackstone is like a blade. It cuts through into our world.

steps.player: Blackstone?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: It comes from the shadows as well. It holds a great power, and many have tried to use it, not knowing the cost of doing so.

steps.player: Is that what happened here?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Yes. They were studying the totem, but in doing so, they followed in our footsteps, dooming their city.

steps.player: Followed in your footsteps? But it wasn't blackstone that destroyed Camdozaal, was it?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Camdozaal was not the first home of my people. From a young age, we are all taught of the Fall of Imcandoria, of the disaster that claimed our city.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: But down here, I have seen the truth. It was no volcano that destroyed our home, it was the totem.

steps.player: The same totem that's now here?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Did it follow us, or did we follow it? Are we fated to be its victims forevermore? Or will the cycle end here? It will soon be time to find out.

options.text: I'd better get going.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: You will need this.
Ketla gives you the blackstone fragment.

options.text: How did you end up down here?
What do you know about this city?
Can you tell me any more about this entity?
I'd better get going.

the-whisperer-while-in-the-shadow-realm.text: Three out of sixteen possible statements are chosen from below:

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is an avalanche of horrors which has discovered your name.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a bard who sings of your final moments.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a blood-soaked record of your darkest moments.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a choir of souls who you will one day meet.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a city of blackstone where the screams are ever silent.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is an empire of darkness where hope flickers and dies.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a judge who has already passed your sentence.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a library of sorrow where your final fate is written.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a monument built in honour of the suffering you desire.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is an ocean of souls where you are one day fated to swim.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is an open wound that bleeds only darkness.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a priest who prays for the oceans of the dead.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a reaper who has a thousand gibbering faces.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a song so loud that you only hear silence.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a stranger who wears a black mask under their skin.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: There is a void that echoes with the cries of those you failed to save.

the-whisperer-while-in-the-shadow-realm.text: One of the two possible statements are chosen from below:

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: Your fate is sealed, [player name], and only one question remains...

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.text: You only have one future, [player name], so ask yourself this...

the-whisperer-while-in-the-shadow-realm.speaker: Strange Voice
the-whisperer-while-in-the-shadow-realm.text: Do you really think you can save them?

options.text: I have a schematic here.

steps.player: I have a schematic here.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Let me see.
You show the schematic to Ketla.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Yes, I think I can work with this. Give me a moment...

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: There. You can collect your new item from the workbench. Let me know if you want any information on how it works.

steps.player: Thanks.

options.text: How did you end up down here?
What do you know about this city?
Can you tell me any more about this entity?
I'd better get going.
Could you tell me more about one of these items?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about one of these items?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Which one?

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Shadow Torch?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Shadow Torch?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: It is a light that will aid you in the shadows, where all other lights fail. It is the only thing that can destroy what lurks there. Use it well.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Shadow Blocker?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Shadow Blocker?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Almost nothing can stop you from being consumed by the shadows, but set the Shadow Blocker down, and it will provide a small area of safety. It's the only safety you'll get.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Revitalising Idol?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Revitalising Idol?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Unless you wish for the void, you must not spend too long in the shadows. Once set down, you can use the Revitalising Idol to give you more time there. But remember, time still always runs out in the end.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Anima Portal?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Anima Portal?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Those that lurk in the shadows do not take kindly to we that still live. They will hunt you. Use the Anima Portal to give them something else to hunt. It provides a glimmer of life in their sea of emptiness.

options.text: Actually, let's talk about something else.
How did you end up down here?
What do you know about this city?
Can you tell me any more about this entity?
I'd better get going.

the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.speaker: Mysterious Voice 1
the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.text: Do not be afraid, my child, for you are not alone. Your voice will be one of thousands, singing an eternal silence.

the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.speaker: Mysterious Voice 2
the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.text: What do I need to do?

the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.speaker: Mysterious Voice 1
the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.text: Seek out our divine order in the cistern below. They will guide you across the waves.

the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.speaker: Mysterious Voice 1
the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.text: Go now, and keep our icon close, for it marks you as one of the chosen. Without it, you are forsaken.

the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.speaker: Mysterious Voice 1
the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.text: And so another voice joins the Silent Choir.

the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.speaker: Mysterious Voice 3
the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.text: He is afraid. He is not ready.

the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.speaker: Mysterious Voice 1
the-whisperer-viewing-the-remnant-in-the.text: It matters not. The day of ascension approaches. His fear will be washed away by the endless sea...

options.text: I have a schematic here.

steps.player: I have a schematic here.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Let me see.
You show the schematic to Ketla.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Yes, I think I can work with this. Give me a moment...

steps.player: What is it?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: This torch schematic. It's a fake.

steps.player: Fake? But how?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: It is marked by the black hand. This is the doing of the Silent Choir.

steps.player: Silent Choir?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: They were the first to fall. It corrupted them and made them its own. They undid the work of those that tried to resist. Harbingers for what was to come.

steps.player: So they stole the real schematic? Where would they have taken it?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: You ask many questions. I have one for you.

steps.player: Really? Is now the best time?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: You did not come to help, but you do so anyway. Why are you here?

steps.player: I'm looking for information on someone known as the Whisperer. I have reason to beleve she was here before the city fell.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: There are many whispers in this city, and it hears them all. Will you join them? Will you join the Silent Choir?

steps.player: Ketla? Are you okay?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: It sees you, [player name]. Did you really think you could hide? Did you really think you could save them?

steps.player: Ketla!

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Huh? What is it?

steps.player: Are you okay? You were in some sort of trance.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: It knows. It knows what we are trying to do. We must hurry. Soon it will be impossible to resist.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: The Silent Choir. They had a church. They built it somewhere in the city. Somewhere hidden.
If the player viewed the remnant in the pub before talking to her:

steps.player: Hmm... I think it might be in the cistern beneath us.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: How do you know this?

steps.player: Something I found earlier. However, it also seemed to suggest that some sort of icon is needed to enter the church.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Then you must find one of these icons. Be quick. Time is not on our side.
If the player did not the remnant in the pub before talking to her:

steps.player: Then we have to find it. Can you think of anywhere that would be a good place to start?

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: The inn. They met there. Hiding in plain sight. Perhaps they left something behind.

steps.player: It's worth a shot. I'll be back soon.

steps.speaker: Ketla
steps.text: Be quick. Time is not on our side.

options.text: How did you end up down here?
What do you know about this city?
Can you tell me any more about this entity?
I'd better get going.

the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-talking-to-ketla-with-the-.text: You have the icon? Good. You should be able to reach the cistern using the drain in the square outside. Hurry.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: There is a song so loud that you only hear silence.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: There is an atrocity written upon blackstone.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: There is a king who presides over a court of corpses.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: There is an ocean of souls where you are one day fated to swim.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: There is a judge who has already passed your sentence.
The screen fully fades to black, and the player appears in the middle of a body of water.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: There is a truth written upon the blackstone, and you cannot escape it.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: Come, [player name]. The Silent Choir awaits you. It is time for your eternal song.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.player: This isn't real! I know this isn't real!

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: You cannot escape your fate, [player name]. The endless sea calls for you.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: Do you really think you can hide, [player name]?

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: [player name]
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: Do you really think you can save them?
The player snaps back to reality.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: [player name]?

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: You were gone too long. I came to find you, but it already had you. You had fallen.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.player: Then how did you save me?

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: The totem. I destroyed it.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: No... I thought destroying the totem would be enough, but it's already too late. It has claimed this place now. We can never undo that.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.player: But surely destroying the totem did something?

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: Its influence has been weakened. Without the totem, it cannot spread beyond this city.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.player: Then you still achieved what you set out to do, right? The surviving Imcando are safe now. You can leave.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: I thought destroying the totem would be the end. I thought it would bring peace...

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: But there is no peace. I still hear their screams. I will never be free of what I did to them.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: Good. Pray that you never have to.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: No more of this. I found the missing schematic in the church. Your new tool is ready. Perhaps you can use it to find what it is you seek here.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.player: The cathedral is the only place I haven't searched.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: There is a darkness there. I thought it was the totem, but clearly not. Something else lurks in those depths...

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: I will not be here when you return. My journey in this place is done. It is time to start a new one. I will leave my things on the workbench for you.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.player: Thank you, Ketla, for everything. Whatever it is you're looking for... I hope you eventually find it.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: Farewell, [player name]. Perhaps we will meet again.

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ketla
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: I will be departing this place soon. Be careful in the cathedral, [player name].

the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.speaker: Ramarno
the-whisperer-inspecting-the-totem-in-th.text: Ah [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.

options.text: What can I do here?
I found another dwarf!

steps.player: I found another dwarf!

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: A dwarf? An Imcando Dwarf?

steps.player: It seems so. Her name is Ketla. I found her in a hidden Zarosian ruin beneath us.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Ketla...

steps.player: You know her?

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: I did, long ago. I thought she was gone. Tell me... was she alone?

steps.player: She was.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: I see... How is she?

steps.player: She's... okay. Things haven't been great for her, but I think the worst is behind her.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: That's good. I hope I get to meet her soon.

options.text: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?

steps.player: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Ah... It's a tough tale to tell. Even though it's been many years since the last of my kin died out, the memory is still fresh.

steps.player: You don't have to tell me if the memory hurts too much.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: No, I will. The legacy of my kin must live on.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: As you can see around you, Camdozaal was once a great city. Alive with the hum of activity. We dug deep into the mountain and reaped the rewards.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Our methods would often differ from other dwarves. Whereas they just used traditional smithing techniques, we would combine them with magic as well.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Alas, that was ultimately our undoing. We learned of a horde of barbarians pillaging across the land, hunting down and killing anyone who dared use magic.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: We underestimated them. We believed our weapons would be enough to keep us safe. We were wrong.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: The barbarians brought ruin upon Camdozaal. Most of my kind died as the city collapsed around them. Only a few of us survived until the end. Now, only I remain.

steps.player: The world has changed a lot, Ramarno. Magic is practiced freely. Those barbarians failed to wipe it from Gielinor.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: I'm glad they didn't win, I suppose. But it doesn't change much for me. The Imcando are all but extinct. I am one of the last to remain.
If Ramarno doesn't know about Thurgo yet:

steps.player: But not the last. Don't forget Ketla.

steps.text: If Ramarno knows about Thurgo:

steps.player: But not the last. Don't forget Thurgo and Ketla.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Yes... You're right, [player name]. I should not be so down. There is still a chance my kind can live on.

options.text: Can I use the Forge?
Never mind, I have no questions for now.

the-desert-treasure-entering-the-ancient.text: A small explosion occurs, knocking the player out.
The player comes to in a prison cell within a temple.

the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.player: It seems I have a knack for that sort of thing. Maybe you underestimated me.

the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.speaker: Mysterious Figure
the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.text: Unlikely. You have displayed moderate skill at best.

the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.player: I assume you have the medallion?
And I'm guessing you're not about to just give it to me?

the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.speaker: Mysterious Figure
the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.text: Correct. You are left with two options.

the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.speaker: Mysterious Figure
the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.text: If you wish, I will allow you to accept your defeat and walk away.

the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.speaker: Mysterious Figure
the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.text: I have gone too long without a worthy challenger. You say I underestimated you? Prove it. Show me a true fight.

the-desert-treasure-inspecting-the-altar.player: Well I'm not backing down now.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Blimey, kid. You don't half take your time, do you? That treasure of ours won't uncover itself!

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Ours? Like I said before, I never actually agreed to work with you.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: What? You're not thinking of double-crossing me, are you?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: I can't double-cross you if I was never working with you to begin with! Besides, we have more important things to worry about than treasure.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Oh, I see what's happening! You're trying to trick me so you can take the treasure for yourself!

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Listen to me! We're not the only ones trying to get into this place! There was this woman who kept trying to steal the medallions. Someone sent her!

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Well of course there will be others who want the treasure! All the more reason for you to stop messing around.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: I'm not going any further until we work out what's going on.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: I really thought you had what it takes, kid, but you're just another fool. If you won't help me find the treasure, I'll just have to do it myself!

Asgarnia Smith throws a smoke bomb toward the player, dazing them. As you come to, you see that he had placed the medallion and opened the way down. Upon climbing down the stairs, the player will walk towards Asgarnia Smith.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: What in the world are you playing at?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Look at it... It's... beautiful!
The camera pans towards the treasure: a large horn on a plinth.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Do you feel that? There's a power radiating off it unlike anything I've felt before...

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: This power... I've felt it before...

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: So you know what it is?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Not exactly. The last time I felt this power, it was something very different creating it.
That said, I reckon I do have some idea as to what this is.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: What?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: The Frostenhorn. I've no idea what it does, but it's a powerful Zarosian artefact that it seems quite a few people are searching for.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Mysterious Voice
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: The Frostenhorn has the ability to amplify power to potentially unimaginable levels.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Mysterious Voice
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Its rediscovery would be revolutionary, but there's just one problem...
The camera pans towards Mysterious Voice, revealing Dr Banikan.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Dr Banikan
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: That's not the Frostenhorn.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Dr Banikan? You followed me here?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Dr Banikan
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: I did. You must forgive me, friend, for I'm afraid I've deceived you in another way as well.
Dr Banikan transforms into Azzanadra.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Azzanadra?!

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: My apologies, but my subterfuge was necessary. There are far too many who would have tried to stop me recovering the Frostenhorn.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: After our earlier encounter, I came to believe it might be here, but it seems I was mistaken.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: But if this isn't the Frostenhorn, then what is it?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: There are many powerful artefacts in this world, but few are truly unknowable. This is one of those few. A relic that predates even the gods themselves.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: It has had many names over many millennia, but to us, it was simply known as the Elder Horn.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: What does it do?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: It grants absolute control. With this, one person has the power to bring entire armies to their knees, all without a single drop of blood being shed.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Hang on... I think I've heard of this artefact. You say it's been known by many names? Was one of them Imperium?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: You are well informed. Perhaps then you also know that the Horn was supposedly sent far to the east, which begs the question as to how it stands before us.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Because there were two.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: What do you mean?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Something I discovered while tracking down Perseriya. It didn't make sense then, but it does now.
The one she took east was a fake. She secretly kept the real one. The intention must always have been to hide it here.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: A clever deception, although it does raise another question. If the Frostenhorn was never here, then where is it?
Hazeel appears before the group.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Azzanadra. It's been a while.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Hazeel. I thought I sensed someone lurking in the shadows. How long have you been here?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Long enough. And in answer to your question, the Frostenhorn was destroyed.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Destroyed? How?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: I was hoping you might be able to enlighten us, considering you were there when it happened.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: I was?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Yes. It was during your little excursion to Ghorrock Prison.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: What?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Enakhra appears before the group.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Enough talk, Hazeel. We have business to attend to. The Elder Horn will be claimed in Zamorak's name.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Enakhra. You knew the Elder Horn was here?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Of course not! Do you really think we'd have left it here for so long if that were the case? We are not fools.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Speaking of fools, I know he's here as well! Reveal yourself!
Akthanakos appears before the group.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Akthanakos
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Gladly.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Were all of you just waiting for me to open this place?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: We had no choice. This vault was sealed with magics that prevented beings like ourselves from opening it.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: It didn't have to be that way, Hazeel. We had proxies available. Had you supported my plan, we'd have the Horn by now.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Unlikely. Your minion failed to recover even one of the medallions.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Akthanakos
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: What a surprise. Enakhra coming up with a flawed plan as usual.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Would you like me to turn you into a boneguard again, you camel-loving coward?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Akthanakos
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: I'd like to see you try. Come, Azzanadra. We can make short work of these traitors and claim the Horn for Zaros.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: You Zarosians have no hope of withstanding the power of two Zamorakian Mahjarrat. The Horn is ours.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Two? We are not the fools you take us for, Enakhra. I can sense five Mahjarrat here, but I only see four.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Akthanakos
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Who are you hiding? Khazard? He always loved lurking in the shadows.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Khazard is attending to business in the North. Surely it is you who is hiding someone.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Akthanakos
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: We do not hide like you do. We came alone.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: But if you all came alone...

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: The camera pans towards Asgarnia Smith.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Oh... hello.
Enakhra casts a revealing spell towards Asgarnia Smith, forcing him to slowly revert into his true form: a Mahjarrat named Sliske.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Sliske. I should have known.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Azzanadra.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: The Serpent himself. Why are you here?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Why am I here?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Well I'm here for the Horn.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: You think you can just take it?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Of course. My friend here and I worked hard for it.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: I'm not your friend! I don't even know you!

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: No? I think you do. I think you know me better than anyone.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: What are you on about?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: You and I have been friends for some time now. Don't you remember?
Sliske transforms into Wizard Persten.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Wizard Persten
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Don't you remember how we survived the horrors of the Scar?
Sliske transforms into the assassin.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Assassin
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Don't you remember how we escaped Ghorrock Prison?
Sliske transforms into Ketla.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Ketla
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Don't you remember how we held back the shadows of Lassar?
Sliske transforms into Kasonde.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Kasonde
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Don't you remember how we overcame the infected Stranglewood?
Sliske transforms back to normal.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: You?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Me.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: So... they were never real? It was all a lie? It was always just you?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: A lie? No. They were all so real, until their lives were cut short. Their stories would have ended, but I stepped in.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: I became them and they became me. In many ways, they're the real me, far more so than the form before you now.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: You used them to manipulate me! Why?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Akthanakos
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: He needed you to open the vault.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: But he didn't need me to get those medallions! He already had one of them!
Were you just toying with me?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Toying? No. It was a test.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: What test?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: To see if you were worthy.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Of what?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Of me.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: You should have contacted me, Sliske. You should have told me about the Horn.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: He clearly wanted it for himself.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: No, not myself. I want the Horn for all of us.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: What nonsense are you on about?

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Do you not see our fate? Over and over, we have our ritual. Over and over, we doom one of our kind to the endless void.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: It's all so... predictable. It's all so... tiresome. And in the end, it will be the death of us all.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: But the Horn will be our salvation. I will use it to break the cycle that has shackled us for so long. We will finally be free.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: The ritual approaches once more, but things will be different this time. This will be the final Ritual of the Mahjarrat.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: He's finally lost it. We can take him. He's alone.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: I'm never alone.
Sliske summons the Barrows Brothers.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Akthanakos
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: You will not be taking that Horn, Enakhra. Not while I stand.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Then I'll just have to kill you first!
Enakhra begins to attack Akthanakos. Meanwhile, Guthan, Dharok, and Ahrim begins to attack Hazeel, while Torag, Karil, and Verac attack Azzanadra. Sliske walks toward the Elder Horn.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Stop! You're not going anywhere with that horn!

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Don't you see, [player name]? I can't stop now. Do you not see our future? Only with the Horn can we make it happen.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: Whatever future you're planning, it ends here!

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: End? No. This is just the beginning. In time, you will see the truth.

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.player: I doubt that!

the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-disputes-of-the-mahj.text: Perhaps some more familiar faces will change your mind.
Sliske summons the Forsaken Assassin, Ketla the Unworthy, Kasonde the Craven, and Persten the Deceitful. He then starts casting a long spell on the Elder Horn.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: A cutscene plays, where Sliske completes his spell and teleports the Elder Horn away.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: You fought well, [player name]. You will be a worthy vessel.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Sliske
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: I'll see you in the North.
Sliske teleports away. The camera pans towards the rest of the group, and the Barrows Brothers disappear as well.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: We have failed.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Hmph!

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Enakhra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: I'll see you at the ritual, Akthanakos. Perhaps this one will be your last.
Enakhra teleports away.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Akthanakos
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Our allies must be informed of this. Come, Azzanadra.
Akthanakos teleports away, and the cutscene ends.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: It seems your pet has broken free of his leash, Azzanadra.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: You know as much as I that Sliske serves no one but himself. His actions are his own.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Yet you have shielded him for centuries. A choice that all of us may now suffer from.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: You can blame me as much as you wish, Hazeel. It is irrelevant. Sliske now holds the Elder Horn and we must be ready to oppose him.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: We? You made your choice a long time ago, Azzanadra. There is no 'we' anymore.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: And yet you yourself admit that Sliske poses a threat to us all. The prospect of working with Zamorakians gives me no pleasure, but it may be the only option.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Perhaps. Perhaps not. Time will soon tell.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Hazeel
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Now, we're done here. I'll see you soon, Azzanadra.
Hazeel teleports away.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Well, adventurer, it seems I owe you an apology.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: I did not show you the trust that you deserved. You freed me from my prison, a feat even my closest followers failed to achieve, and yet I doubted you.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: I did not know your allegiance, and so I was cautious, but it is clear that focusing on allegiances has blinded us. Sliske took advantage of that.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.player: Oh, well thank you, I suppose.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Now, I must ask about the destruction of the Frostenhorn. Sliske's doing?

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Then I fear the other artefacts will have met a similar fate.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: The Frostenhorn was one of three powerful items I was seeking. Together, they may have been my best chance to determine the fate of my lord.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Apparently not, though who could say why. I would never describe Sliske as a true believer, but until now, he always supported the Empty Lord.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Indeed, he himself was entrusted with another of the three artefacts. An icon that was kept under close guard by those wights of his.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.player: Ah... Well unless they were guarding multiple icons, I'm afraid Sliske destroyed that one as well. As for your third artefact, it didn't happen to be on Entrana, did it?

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: I had yet to track it down, but that does seem likely. It was stolen by Saradominists long ago.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.player: Then I think it's safe to say it's been destroyed too. Sliske stole it from Entrana while disguised as that assassin.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: So my worst fears are confirmed. This may well be the darkest day for us since the fall of the Empty Lord.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Since you freed me, I have been driven by a singular purpose. I exist for Zaros. I exist for the Empire. Sliske thinks he has destroyed that purpose, but I will not give up.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: However, that is for another day. There are more immediate matters to concern myself with now. The Ritual of the Mahjarrat is fast approaching, and whatever Sliske is planning will happen there.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: I must ensure I am prepared, and while it may not have been your intention, you are part of this now. You must also ensure you are ready. To help with this, I have something to offer you.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: I understand you are in possession of a ring that lets you see into the Shadow Realm? Considering Sliske's mastery over that place, that is a power that will likely be of great use to you.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: Allow me to upgrade it with some offensive and defensive enchantments. They may well give you an important edge if you find yourself fighting in the shadows.
If the player did not bring their ring of visibility:

steps.player: Thank you. Do you need me to fetch the ring for you?

steps.speaker: Azzanadra
steps.text: No need. I can summon it with ease.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: If the player brought their ring of visibility:

steps.player: Thank you.

the-desert-treasure-aftermath.speaker: Azzanadra
the-desert-treasure-aftermath.text: And on that note, I must leave you, my friend. May you walk in the shadow of the Empty Lord.
Congratulations! Quest complete!

post-quest-dialogue-archmage-sedridor.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
post-quest-dialogue-archmage-sedridor.text: Hello again, [player name]. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
I have news on Persten.

steps.player: I have news on Persten.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Yes?

steps.player: I'm sorry, but she's gone.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: I see. It was always unlikely that she'd survive the Abyss.

steps.player: It wasn't the Abyss. I think she might have been dead long before then. The Persten we spoke to was an imposter.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: An imposter? What do you mean?

steps.player: A Mahjarrat called Sliske was disguised as her.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: I can't believe it. Persten and I had our differences, but this...

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: I'd better share this news with the others. Thank you for bringing it to me.

options.text: How are things at the Temple of the Eye?
More options...

post-quest-dialogue-apprentice-felix.text: If the player has informed Archmage Sedridor about Persten:

post-quest-dialogue-apprentice-felix.speaker: Apprentice Felix
post-quest-dialogue-apprentice-felix.text: Hey, [player name]. I heard about Persten. I can't believe it...

post-quest-dialogue-apprentice-felix.speaker: Apprentice Felix
post-quest-dialogue-apprentice-felix.text: I wish I could have met her... The real her I mean. I bet she'd have known how to properly close this rift.

post-quest-dialogue-apprentice-felix.speaker: Apprentice Felix
post-quest-dialogue-apprentice-felix.text: I guess it's just down to us though. Speaking of which, back to work I guess. Did you have any abyssal pearls you wanted to trade?

options.text: Let's see what you have.
What's that rift guardian doing over there?
Why are you selling things here?
Could you tell me more about this place.
I'm good, thanks.

post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.player: Hello there. How are things here?

post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.speaker: Guard
post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.text: Things aren't easy for the family, especially since they never got closure. They're getting through it, though.

post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.player: Well I'm not sure if it will help them much, but I do have some news on that assassin.
He was actually a Mahjarrat in disguise. I got close to dealing with him, but he escaped.

post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.speaker: Guard
post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.text: A Mahjarrat? I don't even know what one of those is... You say he escaped?

post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.player: For now, but I don't intend to let him keep eluding me forever.

post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.speaker: Guard
post-quest-dialogue-carnillean-guard.text: Well I wish you luck in your search, adventurer. Thank you for the update.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: Ah, [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.

options.text: What can I do here?
I have something to tell you. It's about another dwarf.
options.condition: If the player never told Ramarno about Ketla previously:

steps.player: I have something to tell you. It's about another dwarf.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Another dwarf? An Imcando Dwarf?

steps.player: Yes. I encountered someone I believed to be a dwarf, but it was a lie. It was a Mahjarrat in disguise as someone called Ketla.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Ketla...

steps.player: You knew her?

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: I did, long ago. Is she...

steps.player: She's gone, Ramarno. I'm so sorry.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: I see...

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: I'm sorry, [player name], but let us not speak of this further. To learn of the death of another of my kin is no surprise, but it pains me all the same. I would prefer to focus my thoughts elsewhere.

steps.player: Of course.

options.text: About Ketla...
options.condition: If the player told Ramarno about Ketla previously:

steps.player: About Ketla...

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: What is it?

steps.player: I'm sorry, but the person I thought was Ketla... It wasn't her at all.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: What? But then... what happened to her?

steps.player: She's gone, Ramarno. I'm so sorry.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: I see...

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: I'm sorry, [player name], but let us not speak of this further. To learn of the death of another of my kin is no surprise, but it pains me all the same. I would prefer to focus my thoughts elsewhere.

steps.player: Of course.

options.text: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
Can I use the Forge?
Never mind, I have no questions for now.

post-quest-dialogue-sir-tiffy-cashien.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
post-quest-dialogue-sir-tiffy-cashien.text: Good day Proselyte. Is there anything I can do for you?

options.text: Do you have any jobs for me yet?
I have news on that assassin who attacked Entrana.

steps.player: I have news on that assassin who attacked Entrana.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Ah! Do tell, old bean.

steps.player: Did you know he was a Mahjarrat?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: A Mahjarrat! You must be pulling on my leg, what?

steps.player: His name is Sliske. Have you heard of him?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Sliske, hmm? We have dossiers on many Mahjarrat, but I must confess, this is a new name to me. Poor show! I'll have to see what we have hiding in the archives.

steps.player: While your there, it might be worth looking up something called the Elder Horn. It's an artefact that Sliske has now claimed. One that has the ability to control minds.

steps.text: If the player has not completed While Guthix Sleeps:

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: A mind controlling artefact you say? Sounds like I'll need to report this to the top brass. Can't see them being too thrilled about it. Thank you for the update, old bean.
If the player has completed While Guthix Sleeps:

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: A mind controlling artefact you say? First Lucien and the Stone, and now this! The top brass will need to be made aware. Can't see them being too thrilled about it. Thank you for the update, old bean.

options.text: Can you explain the Gaze of Saradomin to me?
More options...

MC6VRF.player: I should probably read this tablet I found before I go burning everything.
